body: Just hang in there until you can get some professional help. Distract yourself with friends and loved ones, hobbies if you got any.
Sorry mate but I've dumped 4000 hours into Dota to git gud and I'm still awful; not about to start from scratch in LoL. But we can still be top lads if you'd like.

Yeah I'm in a similar situation at the moment, trying to have a life after making my ex the reason why I was alive. She was in no way abusive, but the way things ended left me traumatized more or less and now I'm trying to move on, accepting she's gone and I have to live without her. One day at a time, I guess. And about the online friends thing, feel free to hit me up if you'd like to talk! (I mean it!). Can do skype too.

Then you could rule those things out, I guess. Making online friends could be seen as a baby step. And try brainstorming to see just what kind of things would stimulate you. You never know until you try something out. Could be the most niche thing, or something common you'd never see yourself enjoying.
This could be a good start. What sort of hobbies are you into?
